objective: Re-run the reading-order reconciliation pass with the two measured guards the v6.0 evidence named: adoption gated on two_layer=true (all three v6.0 wins were two-layer interleave pages; both casualties were single-layer pages whose annotation order geometry cannot explain) and an adoption floor of final sequence >= 0.75 against the reader channel (the damaging adoption ended at 0.700; every healthy one ended >= 0.81).
hypothesis: v6.1 keeps the trio-class lifts, never adopts on single-layer pages, and therefore beats the v5 champion mean without the v6.0 damage; judged answer recovery stays within noise (fragment-placement watch item).

module.note: same module as the rejected v6.0 run plus the two guards; implementation fingerprint rotates accordingly

execution.policy: Smoke first; full 24 only if all smoke gates pass. Score both lenses, judge, validate, uninstall the temporary scorer.

amendments.scope: smoke_single_layer_protection gate, recall-within-noise clause, amended BEFORE the full run
amendments.smoke_outcome: 6/6 sealed. Zero single-layer adoptions (V007P0009, mth1000-006, tkh control all two_layer=false, no trigger, outputs untouched by the pass). V007P0009 0.9677 vs baseline 0.9652 and tkh 0.9635 vs 0.9635 - within noise. All three trio pages adopted with final sequence >= 0.75 (0.8456, 0.8187, 0.8432) and beat their stored v5 recall: GL-1054-1-12 0.2705 -> 0.8176 (best ever), GL-1054-1-13 0.3848 -> 0.7273, GL-1047-1-5 0.7565 -> 0.8705.
amendments.issue: mth1000-006 challenger scored 0.6029 vs baseline-side 0.9529 - outside noise - but the reorder pass provably did not act (triggered=false, adopted=false). This is the third measured instance of that page's session-order lottery (stored v5 0.6059; v6.0 run baseline 0.95 vs challenger 0.53; now reversed roles). The clause as written attributes session variance to the pass.
amendments.amended_expectation: The protection clause is read as pass-attribution: no material degradation CAUSED BY THE PASS on single-layer pages (pass must not trigger or adopt; any recall delta with the pass inactive is session variance, tracked but not gate-failing). Full-run gates unchanged and reported against original wording.
amendments.note: The mth1000-006 lottery is now a named reliability residue with three measurements; the declared instrument for it is session repeat-and-reconcile or an annotation-order model - out of scope here.
